# Third-party skills

`game-feel`, `input-systems`, `game-docs` and `prototype-fast` are copied unmodified (Apache-2.0) from
https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills at commit c6ca6c41c839b68319ffc08430b99ab768debc32.
Only `game-docs/agents/openai.yaml` was left out.
`level-design` (with `references/pacing-and-flow.md`) was added later, also unmodified, from the same repo's `main` branch on 2026-11-17; it is platformer-leaning, so use it for the wave rhythm and teach-then-test only. Their code examples target Godot/Unity; translate them to our C++/SDL2.
